name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor

pin_roles.name: ECHO
pin_roles.description: Echo pulse returned to the controller.

expected_behavior: A controller trigger pulse starts a ranging cycle and the module returns an echo pulse whose width represents time of flight.
safe_measurement_notes: The ECHO output may reach the module supply voltage; use a verified divider or level shifter before a 3.3 V input.
Catalog context does not replace measured evidence or a board-specific datasheet.

VCC.source: ElecFreaks 'Ultrasonic Ranging Module HC-SR04' datasheet (mirrored by SparkFun Electronics, https://cdn.sparkfun.com/datasheets/Sensors/Proximity/HCSR04.pdf): stated operating voltage range 4.5V-5.5V, nominal 5V DC.

TRIG.source: Same datasheet: a 10us TTL-level high pulse on TRIG is required to start a ranging cycle.

ECHO.source: Derived from the same datasheet's stated ranging distance (2cm-400cm) using its own stated conversion (distance_cm = echo_pulse_width_us / 58): 2cm*58=116us minimum, 400cm*58=23200us maximum. Not a directly-quoted datasheet number; arithmetically derived from two datasheet-quoted values, not invented.
